findings.recurrence: Twelve matched A-to-B entry profiles completed. Both services/protected input READY; no collected current-build fault, poisoning, reconnect or additional connection events. These are entry profiles, not twelve complete physical round trips.

sourceRefresh.interpretation: Two failure log codes describe one source heartbeat response failure with reader-ended attribution. Same connection resumed protected-ready after about 404ms. No service recovery or reconnect observed; do not describe this run as zero internal errors. Root cause of the response failure is not established.

findings.youngCandidateInterpretation: For reused candidates younger than 10ms, g499 receiver spans remain 142.667-159.812ms versus one g498 sample at 176.742ms. Native pair spans remain 101.124-103.170ms versus 98.428ms. Different samples and system/network load prevent causal attribution; startup overlap alone has not eliminated native readiness tail latency.
findings.expiredInterpretation: Two expired-candidate entries took 262.599/267.532ms receiver read-to-grant, with 133.702/137.597ms service bootstrap validation and 104.822/106.567ms native pair readiness spans. Nested spans must not be blindly added. g498 contained no expired candidate samples, so its lower overall maximum is not a like-for-like benchmark.

retransmission.interpretation: The 259.170ms span residual coincides with 106 retransmitted TCP bytes. Receiver preparation occupied 35.244ms. This supports a separate transport-related contribution; the residual also includes uninstrumented endpoint work and is not a precise one-way network measurement.

inputDispatch.interpretation: Worst vector separates 10ms worker authority, 24ms scope and 74ms apply (coarse quantization). Apply includes native IPC and is not a SendInput-only measurement. Maximum first dispatch was 6.110ms; first and worst are separate vectors.

findings.conclusion: No observed recovery recurrence, but physical performance improvement is not established. Preparation expiry/reconstruction, native child readiness and one active input response spike remain. One retransmission-associated grant wait is a separate category.
findings.nextPriority: Separate native child startup/loading/authentication from binding and service bootstrap validation before another optimization; retain current expiry, authority, ownership and confirmed-cleanup boundaries.

validation.diagnostics: Paired payload SHA256, g499 build filters, installation cutoffs, READY states, unique exchange tags, twelve complete matched profiles and terminal-event absence checked. Historical control.previous.jsonl truncation remains explicitly reported.
